baseName.#text: Coating
涂层

common:generalComment.#text: A coating is a covering that is applied to the surface of an object, usually referred to as the substrate. The purpose of applying the coating may be decorative, functional, or both. Coatings may be applied as liquids, gases or solids. Paints and lacquers are coatings that mostly have dual uses of protecting the substrate and being decorative. A protective coating is a layer of material that is applied to a substrate to prevent it from being damaged by environmental factors such as corrosion, abrasion and weathering.
涂层是涂在物体（通常称为基体）表面的覆盖物。涂覆的目的可以是装饰性的，也可以是功能性的，或者两者兼而有之。涂层可以是液体、气体或固体。油漆和涂料大多具有保护基材和装饰的双重用途。保护涂层是涂在基材上的一层材料，用于防止基材受到腐蚀、磨损和风化等环境因素的破坏。

baseName.#text: Plywood
胶合板

treatmentStandardsRoutes.#text: Semi-finished, manufactured via veneer gluing and pressing

common:synonyms.#text: 胶合板; 工程木材; 人造板

common:generalComment.#text: Plywood is a composite material manufactured from thin layers, or 'plies', of wood veneer that are glued together with adjacent layers, having their wood grain rotated up to 90° to one another. It is an engineered wood from the family of manufactured boards, which include medium-density fibreboard (MDF), oriented strand board (OSB). Plywood is a very popular material used in home building, particularly for its strength as a roofing underlayment.
胶合板是一种复合材料，由薄层或 "层 "木单板制成，这些薄层或 "层 "木单板与相邻层胶合在一起，其木纹相互旋转 90°。它是人造板材家族中的一种工程木材，包括中密度纤维板（MDF）和定向刨花板（OSB）。胶合板是房屋建筑中非常常用的一种材料，特别是作为屋顶垫层时的强度。
